rows.grounds: vijñānameteṣāmutpannaṃ = knowledge-of-these-arisen (vijñānam n.nom.sg; eteṣām gen.pl of etad; utpannam ppp.nom.sg.n √pad with ud)
vikalpāntarayogena = by-connection-with-other-thoughts (instrumental singular of tatpuruṣa/bahuvrīhi-type compound; members: vikalpa, antara, yoga)
nacāpyunmūlitātmakam = and-not-also-uprooted-in-nature (na, ca, api indeclinables; unmūlitātmakam nom.sg.n adjective, compound of unmūlita ppp + ātmaka)
